glow.note: neutral edge glow, 3 soft bands outside every space-facing edge: tint it per line (cyan for neon) and draw it only for lines that glow

notes: Mask bit set = that side of the cell faces open SPACE (not "solid neighbour" as in walls.png): column = N*1 + E*2 + S*4 + W*8. The skin is drawn over a wall cell. It paints a rim (near-black outline, then a lit or shaded edge by facing) on every space-facing side and covers the cell up to 14px in from it, so the last 2px on the far side stay the wall's own interior outline; with no space-facing side (column 0) it is one whole panel. Cells on a thin spar that face space on two sides are covered fully. row = variant: bit0 = no panel joint on the left edge, bit1 = no joint on the top edge (the panel continues from the neighbour). Pick per cell by a position hash so panels read 1-3 cells long. Neutral greys only (K D E W S M L): multiply a tint per culture line (scrap rust, standard clean, neon dark navy).
